response.sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pair_counts), compared AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS average_type_share FROM pair_shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_type_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share >= average_type_share GROUP BY tradekind;
